setup: LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=300, num_leaves=63, learning_rate=0.1), 7-class family target, 150,000-row random training sample, top-40 ranked features; validation = full validation split
conclusion: Training loss rising after iteration 27 shows numerical divergence, not overfitting. Requiring a minimum hessian of 1 per leaf fixes it; adopted as default in src/models/lightgbm_model.py and all LightGBM uses.
